name: Chorley Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Chorley Community Centre. Open Tue and Fri for distribution. Referral required.

name: Chorley Council Allotments
image: and Eaves Lane. Plots from £25/year. Waiting lists available. Includes water access and tool storage.

name: Chorley Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Astley Park. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Open weekends during growing season.
